info.name: ValueSERP Search News API
info.description:
Real-time Google SERP data API supporting organic search, shopping, news, images, places, and product results via simple GET requests authenticated with an API key. Returns structured JSON with organic results, ads, knowledge graphs, answer boxes, AI overviews, and more. Operated by Traject Data.

Contact Support:
 Name: ValueSERP Support

query.description: (Required) Your ValueSERP API key. Use "demo" for testing limited queries.
(Required) Must be set to "news".
(Required) The keyword or search query to use.
Geographic location for the search. Accepts location names (e.g., "manhattan,new york,united states") or GPS coordinates (e.g., "lat 43.437677,lon 3.8392765").
When true, automatically updates gl and hl parameters based on the built-in location value. Defaults to true.
The Google domain to use for the search.
Determines the Google country to use for the query. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
Determines the Google UI language to return results in. BCP-47 language code.
Limits results to pages in the specified language.
Limits results to pages from the specified country.
The results page number to retrieve. Defaults to 1.
Retrieve multiple result pages in a single API request. Specifies the maximum page number to retrieve.
Safe search filter setting.
Exclude auto-corrected spelling results. Set to 1 to exclude, 0 to include (default).
Toggle similar/omitted result filters. 1 enables filtering (default), 0 disables it.
Custom Google TBS parameter value for advanced filtering.
Custom Google UULE parameter to override the location.
Filter results by time period.
Custom time period start date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Required when time_period=custom.
Custom time period end date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Required when time_period=custom.
Sort news results by relevance or date.
Display duplicate results when sort_by=date is used.
Exclude results from queries that were modified by Google.

request.description: Retrieve real-time Google News results for a given keyword. Set search_type=news. Supports time period filtering, language, country, and sorting.
